local_context.value: The municipality is the City of Folly Beach, a city on Folly Island in Charleston County; infobox elevation 0 ft. 2020 census: population 2,078; median age 57.4; 32.4% aged 65 or older; 2,391 housing units (55.8% vacant). The City's permit page lists an Elevation Certificate, a Folly Beach V Zone Form and a Substantial Improvement Package for Floodplain Construction among its permit forms.

place_entities.value: Folly Beach Fishing Pier and Folly Beach County Park (Charleston County Parks); Morris Island Lighthouse (Save the Light); Folly Boat (on Folly Road); Center Street

permit_office.value: City of Folly Beach Building & Planning Department issues building permits ("Building permits are required for all new construction, remodeling, and repairs"); permits@follybeach.gov, (843) 588-2447; new-construction packages submitted electronically. Not Charleston County.
